reviews.text:
I’ve been taking my dog to see dr Joana for nearly 3 years now. The attention and care my pup gets is exceptional. The friendliness of all
The staff is excellent. Highly recommend!

Sadly, my dog ​​passed away during a tartar removal procedure at this clinic.

Although I know this can happen, I'm sharing my account and assessment of this very sad situation.
Great place. Friendly and competent vets!

My animals have all been followed at the clinic for many years and I have no reason to complain. The team is amazing and always available to help the furry friends!
I was present at the situation that a lady complains about here this week and I have to say that nothing is true, the team was super helpful.

Arrogant and insolent service from Mr. Hélio, with total disregard for the client and their pet, who have already spent a small fortune this year alone.
For my part, they lost a customer and from now on I will not recommend them to anyone, making sure to share my negative experience.

You always have to wait more than one hour to be called and no every time the mood of the doctors are welcoming or nice. They have a high turnover of doctors. I had always taken my dog ​​there, but the service is no longer the same. When I went to ask for a travel certificate, they told me that it was my responsibility to know the documents and requirements, that they were not obligated to provide them. I don’t think I’ll come back. What a pity
Very friendly!
Front-end and veterinarians friendly, speak great English and the vets explain everything to you.
My dog ​​has been coming to this place for a year now and is always well treated. The receptionists are also very friendly. We are usually seen by Dr. Joana.
Amazing vet
Great place! All the veterinarians I’ve attended with my cat do the job with care and love for pets

I've been a client for over 3 years and I couldn't be happier. I've always received excellent service and advice. It's clear that, in addition to loving animals, they also care deeply about people—they treat them with respect, empathy, and even sensitivity regarding costs.

My Dalmatian, who is very sensitive and spoiled, is always received calmly and affectionately by all the professionals. They explain everything in detail, from the procedures to the reasons behind them, so I understand exactly what's being done.

They are all incredibly friendly and, although scheduling is important, they usually manage to find time for me. That makes all the difference!

I trust them completely and would never change veterinarians. I recommend them 100%!
They are only friendly to purebred dogs!
I called and they told me I could arrive until 8 PM for appointments. I crossed the city and when I arrived here before 7:30 PM they refused to see my cat. Terrible!
A 5-star clinic in every sense, it has undoubtedly become my go-to clinic.
Wonderful! Dr. Inês is excellent.
Very professional and open to every question we had as fresh dog owner. They really take the time. Especial thanks to Inês.
excellent professionals

I recently visited the clinic with my kitten, Paris, and was truly impressed by the experience! The staff were incredibly friendly and made us feel so welcome from the moment we walked in. They took time to get to know Paris and were very gentle, which helped him feel comfortable during his exam. It’s clear they genuinely care about animals here. Highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner looking for a warm, knowledgeable, and compassionate team!
Excellent. Dr. Rita was incredibly kind and caring towards my kitten. Thank you so much.
